about: The module's pixel glyphs, every one, as rows of '.' and '#' (E48 G1, 10.11.2026). One source: tools/glyph-map.mjs
writes icons/pixel-sprite.svg, styles/pixel-icons.css and the audit page's symbols from the rows of family px that
name no sheet, and tools/chrome-icons.mjs writes danganronpa.css's chrome section from the rows of family chrome.
A row that names a `sheet` is drawn there today by hand as a data URI (`prop` a custom property, `rule` the first
selector of a rule's mask): `node tools/glyph-map.mjs --check` holds each such URI to its rows pixel for pixel,
until E48 G4 generates them too. Fields: family (where the drawing lives: px the generated set, g/r/pix the
stylesheets' --drpg-g-/-r-/-pix- custom properties, chrome Foundry's chrome masks), name (unique in its family),
grid (the rows are grid wide and grid tall), from (where the drawing came from), audit (one of the audit page's
originals, docs/design/identity-audit-v13.html), note (what the drawing is, from its old source's comment), key (chrome-icons.mjs's class key), same (this row draws the
pixels of the named family:name on purpose - any other two rows that draw the same pixels are a fault).

glyphs.name: monokuma-eye
glyphs.from: tools/chrome-icons.mjs's art, as styles/danganronpa.css holds it
glyphs.note: Monokuma's jagged red eye, the point slashing outward. The key is not a Font Awesome class on purpose: the launcher is its only wearer, and the generator routes this sprite to `#drpg-gm-launcher i` directly, so the `<i>`'s own class stays a plain fallback glyph. Drawn against Dawid's reference (26.08), corrected once more to it: the TOP is not one smooth sweep - a horn rises at about a third of the width and a concave notch drops behind it before the long climb to the tall right tip. The left tip is a one-pixel point. Below, two scooped arcs hang cusps of different depths: the first claw (~38% width) reaches lowest, the second sits further right (~71%) and higher. On the 24 grid, not 12: these curves die at 12px. The generator picks the viewBox per sprite, so this one costs the others nothing.
